sources.snippet: In contrast, a single UniMate model covers a far broader range of skeletons, from humans and animals to general articulated objects, accepts text conditioning, and animates a rigged mesh end-to-end, without reference motion or per-skeleton training.

sources.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
sources.snippet: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion ...
